let step = 8.0D

let diagonal = step * Math.sqrt(2.0D)

expand(order: int) -> string =>
    (let current mut = "F--XF--F--XF"

     for _ in 0..order do
         current = current.replace("X", "XF+G+XF--F--XF+G+X")
     od

     current)

let image = IMAGE(540, 540)
let pen = TURTLE(image)

image.view(0.0D, 0.0D, 540.0D, 540.0D)
image.colour(0ub, 0ub, 160ub)
image.stroke(1.2D)

pen.move_to(266.0D, 514.0D)

for letter in expand(order) do
    if letter == 'F' then
        pen.forward(step)
    elif letter == 'G' then
        pen.forward(diagonal)
    elif letter == '+' then
        pen.turn(45.0D)
    elif letter == '-' then
        pen.turn(-45.0D)
    fi
od
